description: Maven Bio helps life sciences teams research drugs, companies, clinical trials, targets, and indications in ChatGPT. Map competitive pipelines, investigate licensing deals and financing rounds, compare public-company financials, and find the source documents behind research claims. Connect an existing Maven Bio account to retrieve saved reports, tables, charts, and monitor signals you can access.
